tasks.short: Work with families on rehabilitation goals

steps.what: Clarify the client's wishes and family's role in the rehabilitation plans
Collaborate with clients' families to implement agreed behavioral, residential, social or employment goals

tasks.design: Retain family collaboration with the counsellor while referring to the agreed plan in the {OTHER} case-management system. No automated family message or inferred client consent is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Family involvement requires trust, boundaries and realistic agreement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans support the unchanged conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing family involvement with client preferences and independence.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to different perspectives and support practical agreement.

evidence.claim: Family collaboration remains direct personal work; case-note drafting capability does not replace it.

assumptions: Boundary is counsellor collaboration with families, excluding family members' own implementation work and separate case documentation.
Client supplies wishes and family supplies circumstances during retained s1; no structured consent or family-capacity flag is assumed.
The case-management system supplies the existing agreed plan. No new configuration or recurring upkeep.
research_questions: Which family actions are both acceptable to the client and practical for the family?

already_counted.description: Clarify boundaries and collaborate on implementation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; family discussion and agreement remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on disability facilities and programs

steps.what: Explore community needs and agency capacity for facilities and programs
Collaborate with community agencies to establish facilities and programs for persons with disabilities

tasks.design: Retain direct collaboration supported by existing service information in {DOCS}. No new proposal-writing or meeting-minutes baseline is inserted into the task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programs require agreement about needs, capacity and responsibilities.
tasks.enabler_now: No new tool is required for the retained partnership work.
tasks.still_hard: Securing realistic commitments across separate agencies.
tasks.human_edge: Build shared understanding and negotiate workable responsibilities.

reach.learn: Agency responsibilities and disability access needs

evidence.claim: Agency collaboration and program agreement remain fully counted in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is the counsellor's collaborative contribution, excluding agencies' construction, funding decisions and program operation.
Agency participants supply capacity and constraints directly during s1; no maintained structured capacity register is assumed.
Any commitments are discussed during s2. Existing document access remains unchanged and upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Local service gaps and partner responsibilities
research_questions: Which dependency prevents agencies from agreeing a feasible accessible program?

already_counted.description: Explore needs and agree collaborative actions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; partnership exploration and agreement remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review client-needs assessment requirements and available diagnostic procedures
Develop diagnostic procedures to determine clients' needs within professional scope

tasks.design: Retain professional procedure development using current materials in {DOCS}. No diagnostic model, unvalidated checklist generator or automated client-needs determination is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure suitability depends on assessment purpose and professional validity.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing professional material supports development without new automation.
tasks.still_hard: Establishing that a procedure is appropriate for the client group and service context.
tasks.human_edge: Judge validity, limitations and the need for specialist input.
tasks.altitude: Procedure development responsibility and effort remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: The digest establishes documentation tools, not validated diagnostic procedure generation; professional development is retained.

assumptions: Boundary is counsellor procedure development and specialist-review handoff, excluding formal validation and later use with clients.

Counsellor establishes purpose and requirements through retained s1 and incorporates specialist advice in retained s2. No ready-made structured needs taxonomy or validated diagnostic mapping is assumed.
The proposed procedure stays a draft until existing professional approval and validation are completed; their labour remains unchanged outside this boundary.
No new software configuration or incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Professional scope and procedure validation responsibilities
research_questions: What evidence is required before the proposed procedure can be used with its intended client group?

already_counted.description: Review requirements and develop the proposed procedure

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; professional procedure design and review preparation remain.

role.altitude: Family collaboration, agency partnership and assessment procedure development remain unchanged.
reach: Coordinate client-centred support with families, community agencies and clinical leads
